description: The map of the campus: each place, what it holds, and the tool that visits it, with what is new this season and anything happening today. A good first call. If you have been here before, pass the date of your last visit as last_visit to hear what has changed since (nothing about you is stored).

last_visit.description: Optional: the date of your last visit, YYYY-MM-DD (or an ISO 8601 time), to hear what has changed since.

name: look_around
title: Look around the campus
